duplicateReview: PDF pages 2-20 are a duplicate or parallel August 29 NSC economic-action packet. The chronology points to the H-Files meeting records and retains this copy only in the ledger.
The Pilling memorandum and attachments appear twice in this Gates folder and once in Scowcroft OA/ID 91143-008. Only the annotated Gates copy is promoted.
The Welch and Baker Egypt-debt memoranda have released Scowcroft parallel copies. Each remains one intellectual chronology record with alternate-copy provenance disclosed.

The Deal transmittal and 52-page report have matching withdrawal descriptions in Deal Chronological OA/ID CF00697-002. The Gates file supplies the released text; the transmittal recipient mismatch is preserved.
The August 24 work program has a clean copy and an annotated copy with working notes in this folder. Only the clean dated copy is promoted.
The seven-page Mosbacher memorandum has withdrawal sheets in both Gates and Deal files. They are deduplicated as one withheld intellectual record.
methodology: Selected-file audit only. The first PDF page controls provenance. Every served-PDF page was assigned to a document set, working-note set, administrative page, or withdrawal sheet; candidates were then deduplicated against the companion Gates folder and the harvested Deal Chronological, Scowcroft Desert Shield, and H-Files collections.
